Dural Reflections and Dural Venous Sinuses
• periosteal and meningeal layers of dura generally fused
• dural reflections: rigid partitions
that subdivide the cranial cavity
– formed by infoldings of the
meningeal layer of dura
• dural venous sinuses along
lines of dural reflection
– convey venous blood
from brain to internal
jugular vein
